prompt: Convert $5$ meters to centimeters. ($1$ m $= 100$ cm)
hint: A centimeter is much shorter than a meter, so it takes many of them to match each meter. Will the answer be larger or smaller than $5$?

hints.text: A centimeter is much shorter than a meter, so it takes many of them to match each meter. Will the answer be larger or smaller than $5$?
Each meter is $100$ centimeters, so multiply the $5$ meters by $100$.
$5 \times 100 = 500$, so a length of $5$ meters is $500$ centimeters.

explanation: The problem gives the fact that $1$ meter equals $100$ centimeters.
Converting to the smaller unit means multiplying, so set up $5 \times 100$.
Multiplying by $100$ puts two zeros after the $5$, giving $500$.
Five meters are the same length as $500$ centimeters.
